notes.title: v1.1.0 Update - Steam Community Presence o(￣▽￣)d
notes.notes:
[b][i]Drummer Talent VR[/i][/b] has not updated for a while, some players even wondered if we’ve given up the game. Unfortunately, it is not the case. We will add new features step by step, and keep the goals, which we mentioned in our [b]Early Access[/b] announcement, in our mind. If you like drumming game or rhythm game, please don't hesitate to follow!

Now let's see, what are the changes of this new update?

[h1]New Tracks:[/h1]
[olist]
[*][b]Without You – Pop[/b] (Hard, Expert, Master)
[*][b]Power Surge – Pop[/b] (Normal, Hard, Master)
[*][b]Let Me Go Home – Rock[/b] (Normal, Hard, Expert)
[*][b]Aggressor – Rock[/b] (Hard, Expert)
[/olist]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[olist]
[*][b]Steam Leaderboards[/b] added! Now we have not only an integrated ranking list but also ranking lists of each track.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/2a4c11b7fc9e018e00c7e071d103c3288ee26532.png[/img]

[*][b]Steam Achievement[/b] added! Now you can clearly find out if you’ve made progress or not. More achievements you’ve completed means more progress you’ve made.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/4b2ed4e3cb5a5547e085bf4d6609a311b2188087.png[/img]

[*][b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] added! As you play our game long enough, you can get cards now.


[*][b]New Scene - Space Stage[/b] added! Wow, we can even play drums in the space now? How amazing! ヽ(°◇° )ノ
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/c04425b5e03cd0cfa405ee59697791488c16320d.png[/img]

[*][b]Free Play Mode[/b] added. Now you can play your favorite songs’ drum cover! Plug your own foot switches to your computer and bind them to your keyboard. To get in the Free Play Mode, jump into “Track”- “Easy”- “Free Play” in the main interface.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/65cfdda33186b56fb72372b3c539ce29d918213c.gif[/img]
(The Hi-Hat binds to “Z” key, and Kick Drum binds to “Space bar”)

[*]Drum audios loaded from external! Now if you are not satisfied with the default audios of the drums or cymbals, you can replace them with your own audio files.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/00828b19fd5bbfb5cf1b64c9793cfb750838298d.gif[/img]

[*]Sound volume is relevant to your hitting power! That’s right, now you can hit the drums harder to increase the volume.
[/olist]

[h1]Optimization & Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Now you can hit the Bass Drum with drum sticks.
[*]Now whether the game has system focus, you can play the game normally.
[*]Now while we’re playing drums, it no longer triggers the collision event of drumsticks.
[*]Optimized the AI logic of the paper men. Now they are less likely to act silly.
[*]Optimized some localization descriptions. Now they are easier to read.
[*]Optimized some scenes’ rendering efficiency. Now they render smoother than before.
[*]Fixed one problem which causes a Miss during the process of opening and closing Hi-Hat.
[*]Fixed the problem that the first rhythm note is 100% Miss of some tracks.
[*]Fixed the problem that purple rhythm notes are shown in blue.
[/olist]

[h1]New features in next update (Not final version)[/h1]
[olist]
[*]New tracks
[*]New instrument - Cowbell. 
[*]Foot rhythm notes (Hi-Hat and Bass Drum rhythm) added into tracks. (Could be turned off if you don’t have external foot devices)
[*]Place each drum and cymbal to the location you like by yourself.
[/olist]
